## Summary

**MOVEC** (Move Control register): Control (Special Purpose) register request/set.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `Control → d` |
| Syntax | `MOVEC Rc,Rn` getting info is allowed on 080 in user mode<br>`MOVEC Rn,Rc` ! Super mode only |
| Short | Control (Special Purpose) register request/set |
| Description | Some useful event counters to look at. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–1 | `010011100111101` |
| 1 | 0 | d |
| 2 | 15 | a |
| 2 | 14–12 | Register |
| 2 | 11–0 | Control Register |

- a=1: address register else data register
- direction d=0: Rc to Rn else Rn to Rc
- Greyed out are not present in recent cores.

### Control registers

Event counters increase by one when that event happens.

| Rc | Name | Meaning | Marked * in the original | Grayed out in the original |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $808 | PCR | Processor Configuration Register | no | no |
| $809 | CCC | Clock Cycle Counter | yes | no |
| $80A | IEP1 | Instructions Executed Pipe 1 | yes | no |
| $80B | IEP2 | Instructions Executed Pipe 2 | yes | no |
| $80C | BPC | Branches Predicted Correct | yes | yes |
| $80D | BPW | Branches Predicted Wrong | yes | yes |
| $80E | DCH | Data Cache Hits | yes | yes |
| $80F | DCM | Data Cache Miss | yes | yes |
| $00A | STR | STalls Register | yes | yes |
| $00B | STC | STalls Cache | yes | yes |
| $00C | IEP3 | Instructions Executed Pipe 3 (was STH STalls Hazard ) | yes | partly |
| $00D | STB | STalls Buffer | yes | yes |
| $00E | MWR | Memory WRites | yes | yes |

### PCR: Processor Configuration Register ($808)

Bit layout as drawn in the original:

| Bits | Content |
|---|---|
| 31–16 | `0000010001000000` |
| 15–8 | `00000001` |
| 7 | ede |
| 6 | a |
| 5–2 | `0000` |
| 1 | dfp |
| 0 | ess |

| Bits | Name | Default | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31-16 | id | $0440 = 080 | $0430 = 060 |
| 15-8 | revision | 1=v4 , 0=v2 | (1 on 060) |
| 7 | edebug | 0 | 1=slow mode, bit 6 selects what. |
| 6 | amiga | 0 | 1=A1200, 0=A500 |
| 1 | dfp | 0 | 1=disable float point unit |
| 0 | ess | 1 | 1=enable super scalar (second pipe) |

Speed table for bits 7–0, slow to fast:

| Bits 7–0 | Mode | Apollopad back+ |
|---|---|---|
| $80 | slow A500 always 1pipe | a |
| $c0 | slow A1200 always 1pipe | b |
| $40 | slow A3000 always 1pipe | x |
| $00 | full 1pipe |  |
| $01 | full 2pipes | y |

- id & revision are read only, writing has no effect.
- Deactivating icache = always “slow A500 always 1pipe”

### Notes

- PRIVILEGED INSTRUCTION.
- On 68080 reading a control register may be done in user mode.

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have MOVEC. This page covers only the 68080 addition: new control registers (event counters, PCR) that user mode may read. For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T write control registers in user mode: MOVEC Rn,Rc is supervisor only. Reading is allowed.
